TC-20/S05.title: Nursing Home dashboard has the two tabs and the Hospital design; Hospital has no tabs
TC-20/S05.detail: PW, local stack 25acd727, model mocked or blocked at the socket (tripwire clean). Judged 7/7, 1 record-only. Hospital (from the list's Dashboard control): 'Rounding Dashboard', tiles Total / Pending / In Progress / Done, row 'Room 4B-05 · 0 tasks pending' + badge, no tab, no In Today control, no resident. Nursing Home (Hospital toggle -> Nursing Home -> bottom bar Dashboard): the same heading and the same four tiles, role=tab 'Today's Visits' (selected) and 'All Residents', row 'Cedar 5 · 0 tasks pending' + badge, no Hospital patient. Same layout and classes (screenshots tc20-s05-hospital / -nursing-home).
